en: A monochrome vintage street scene showing a tree-lined avenue with tram tracks running along a cobbled road. A horse-drawn carriage is visible at the right edge, and a few pedestrians walk in the distance. The right margin is filled with handwritten text in a cursive script, typical of early 20th‑century postcards. The image carries a small printed credit and a watermark from elia.org.gr near the bottom.
